Morgan - People Ops: Jamal flagged an out-of-cycle request: manager wants salary bump + title change effective 2026-03-01 but hire date is 2026-03-12. Can we backdate salary and title? What paperwork/timelines?

Jamal - Eng Manager: manager prefers retro to 3/1 to keep reporting simple. candidate signed offer listing 3/12. they want SWE II -> SWE III and new comp effective 3/1.

Elena - Comp Analyst: salary: usually possible with signed amendment. We prorate by days for retro unless policy says otherwise. Equity: do NOT backdate grants that affect eligibility/vesting without comp/legal OK.

Priya - Payroll: operationally we need signed amendment, comp-approved backpay calc, payroll reason code and tax memo (for EMEA). payroll cutoff for March run: 2026-03-25 23:59 PST. We'll only execute after People Ops clearance. Sample command we use:

run_adjust --eid 004987 --period 2026-03 --retro 2026-03-01 --amt <backpay> --notes "OC comp retro"

Alex - HRBP: benefits start = hire date (3/12). cannot retro-enroll. Title in HRIS can be set to 3/1 if docs permit.

Marta - Legal EMEA: caution: many EMEA countries require the person to have been employed on the retro period for taxes to be remitted. If they weren't on payroll we might classify as sign-on or require special filings. Send country and contract and we'll advise. Also include language in amendment about tax liabilities.

Jamal - Eng Manager: thanks. I'll get signed amendment today. Quick on math: Elena, do we use days_in_month or /365?

Elena - Comp Analyst: we prefer daily pro-rate using 365 base for simplicity: ((new_annual - old_annual)/365) * days_prior. days_prior = days from effective date until day before hire. Example: 3/1->3/11 = 10 days.

Priya - Payroll: note: large one-time amounts may affect withholding; payroll will produce tax memo and may split payment if needed.

people-bot: payroll cutoff reminder: 4 days left until 2026-03-25 23:59 PST.

Morgan - People Ops: action list: 1) Jamal upload amendment + ping here. 2) Elena posts backpay calc. 3) Alex/Marta confirm country rules. 4) Priya confirms run. I'll close when payroll run authorized.
